content.short: Cross-border business accounts, FX and bulk payouts.
content.description: Cedar Money, founded in 2022, is a cross-border payments company that uses stablecoins to move money between developed and emerging markets, with a strong focus on African corridors. It gives businesses, fintechs, and exporters virtual accounts, competitive foreign exchange, and bulk payout tools wrapped in a familiar fiat interface, while settling on the backend over blockchain networks such as Ethereum and Tron. With T+1 settlement, stablecoin-to-fiat off-ramps, and compliance built in, Cedar Money helps companies avoid the delays, high fees, and banking restrictions of traditional correspondent networks. Backed by a seed round led by QED Investors, it positions stablecoins as invisible infrastructure behind reliable international B2B payments.
content.meta: Cedar Money enables cross-border B2B payments using stablecoins into emerging markets. Discover Cedar Money and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
